profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Indeed.com
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 1 year of experience leading a development team and 7+ years of programming experience in a full-stack agile development environment. Proficient in the LAMP stack, with extensive experience developing large-scale applications with technologies such as Java, Ruby on Rails, Python, and AWS SQS/SNS/Lambda, while creating and maintaining strong coding standards.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led efforts to combine our two products (job requirements and screener questions), including creating design doc, facilitating meetings, creating and assigning tickets, and implementing backend functionality
- Started migration efforts to get our APIs onto our federated supergraph, including creating design docs, leading API review discussions, and implementing a POC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented read-store pub-sub system with RabbitMQ for all product, category and order updates
- Enhanced Magento GraphQL filter and sort functionality

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Fulfilled Tech Lead duties for our Order Management and Logistics Back-End Team:
- Lead architect for Financial Automation Tracker, which utilizes a task queue and
delayed jobs to transform data into accounting documents
- Mentor and provide guidance to junior developers to improve their skills
- Facilitate meetings and draft tech specs to improve the quality of quarterly
planning breakout sessions
- Lead sprint planning and refinement sessions to groom the backlog

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed EDI Processor, a tool used to transform orders into the EDI format,
which is commonly used by factories to fulfill orders
- Developed Magento custom extensions to provide revision, accommodation,
return, and exchange functionality to the E-commerce platform
- Standardized the ETL class structure and debugged issues with long-running
Laravel cron jobs
- Created database migration and table creation standards

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Experience working on various projects/tasks in an Agile SDLC, including:
- Implemented CapMaster, an algorithm for prioritizing a large list of leads based on buyer capacity and lead revenue potential
- Investigated alternative phone validation with A/B tests, and analyzing the result dataset, ultimately saving ~30% in phone validation costs
- Planned and facilitated integration of REST API for new email platform (dotmailer)
- Created various ETLs to retrieve essential client data for internal reporting and analysis
- Developed Chrome Extensions for internal use to improve the efficiency of call agents, and also to improve JIRA quality
- Automate important tasks triggered from configuration changes using Amazon SNS/Lambda

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a C# GUI along with an associated database schema with full
database editing functionality, allowing the risk team to fully customize risk levels
- Integrated database schema with existing architecture components and integration tests
- Designed and implemented a C# GUI connected to a SQL database, providing end-users with the ability to monitor and update critical price information in real time

positions.title: Tech Intern
positions.description:
Created PHP scripts to expedite the conversion of ASP data into WordPress xml files
Implemented a full conversion of an ASP flat file website into a fully functional WordPress website 
Performed regular design maintenance for various client websites

positions.title: Operations Manager
positions.description:
Managed membership database of 300+ members and financial operations of over $100,000
Analyzed membership data and created visuals to assist in improving membership cost structures
Established standards to improve the accuracy and efficiency of overall financial processes

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Provided math tutoring services for students levels: 1st grade to Precalculus

positions.title: Blogger
positions.description:
Researched and submitted articles on technological innovations as ideas for blog posts
Drafted blogs for the company website along with related posts for social networks

positions.title: Audit Support Specialist
positions.description:
Responded to data requests from client properties as well as auditors
Researched and made detailed investigations into audit inquiries
Identified audit issues/irregularities and made recommendations

positions.title: Accounting Intern
positions.description:
Integrated all operating budgets into QuickBooks
Maintained all nonprofit accounting records and prepared financial reports
Streamlined bookkeeping and record keeping processes

positions.title: Economic Development
positions.description:
Updated and catalogued statistical data for the Business Industry Data Center Program
Drafted a template for a database on the status of proposed bills

company.name: Office of the Governor, State of Texas

positions.title: Customer Service Representative                            Summer
positions.description:
Managed a cash draw for cash and credit card transactions
Handled customer inquiries and corrected billing problems
